verdicts.evidence: Deal closure target Q4-CY26 or Q1-CY27 has not yet occurred as latest data is up to Q2 FY27 (Sep 2026).
Management expects USD 25‑30 million transaction costs over the next two quarters (T1-16).
Operating margin was 16% in Q1 FY27 but fell to 14% in Q2 FY27, below the 16‑17% target.
No data on approval timeline or merger progress provided.
TCV growth figure not disclosed in reported numbers.
Bridge financing interest rate not disclosed.
Revenue grew from ₹3,334 Cr (Q2 FY26) to ₹4,303 Cr (Q1 FY27) and margin stayed at 19% then fell to 16% in Q1 FY27, indicating mixed accretion.
Operating margin hit the lower bound 16% in Q1 FY27 but dropped to 14% in Q2 FY27, missing the 16‑17% range.
Effective tax rate for Q2 FY27 is 22.5% (within guidance) but FY26 tax rate is not reported.
